# Kuvaira

> Kuvaira is a premium corporate and personal gifting studio creating thoughtful, curated gifts for employees, clients, milestones, celebrations, and events.

## What Kuvaira offers

- Curated gift boxes and thoughtful gifting recommendations
- Corporate and bulk gifting support
- Personalisation, notes, packaging, and approved brand elements where available
- Delivery coordination for eligible single- and multi-address requests

## Helpful pages

- [Home](https://kuvaira.in/): brand overview, selected work, and enquiry paths
- [About Us](https://kuvaira.in/about): who Kuvaira is and how the studio works
- [Collections](https://kuvaira.in/portfolio): curated gift collections
- [Corporate Gifting](https://kuvaira.in/corporate-gifting): employee, client, festive, and wedding gifting
- [Our Process](https://kuvaira.in/process): how a gifting project runs end-to-end
- [FAQs](https://kuvaira.in/faqs.html): answers about quantities, budgets, timelines, customisation, and delivery
- [Contact](https://kuvaira.in/contact): start a gifting enquiry
- [Privacy Policy](https://kuvaira.in/privacy-policy.html)
- [Terms and Conditions](https://kuvaira.in/terms-and-conditions.html)

For a useful recommendation, include the occasion, approximate quantity, budget, destination, and deadline.
